lines.en: label beachfive14:
scene utaioinn1
Because it surely shan’t help you no matter what it was, but that alone doesn’t put an end to my curiosity.
lines.zh: 因为不管那是什么，它肯定都帮不了你，但仅此一点并不能浇灭我的好奇心。

lines.en: You see, it rains every day where I come from. But that’s simply a side effect of losing someone you love.
lines.zh: 你瞧，我来的那个地方每天都下雨。但那不过是失去所爱之人的副作用。

lines.en: I never have to worry about my plants getting thirsty. I never have to worry about my balcony getting covered in dust. But I do have to worry about floating away from time to time.
lines.zh: 我从来不用担心我的植物会渴。我从来不用担心阳台积灰。但我确实得时不时担心自己会飘走。

lines.en: Just like you do now.
lines.zh: 就像你现在一样。

lines.en: Can you feel it? The tide closing in? The way fish feel against your calves as broken shells dig deep into the wounds you earned when you walked on glass?
lines.zh: 你能感觉到吗？潮水正在逼近？鱼群擦过你小腿的触感，而碎贝壳深深扎进你踩着玻璃走来时所留下的伤口里？

lines.en: I hope you can.
lines.zh: 我希望你能。

lines.en: Because you are the reason it rains every day here.
lines.zh: 因为这里每天都下雨，是你造成的。

lines.en: {i}You{/i} are the reason I am wounded.
lines.zh: 是{i}你{/i}，让我遍体鳞伤。

lines.en: But I will never stop loving you because-
lines.zh: 但我永远不会停止爱你，因为——

lines.en: Well...
You’ll find out one day.
lines.zh: 总有一天你会知道的。

lines.en: Anyway, here’s Io. It’s relevant.
lines.zh: 总之，Io 来了。这很关键。

lines.en: : You don’t have to sit here with me all night, Uta. Go be social and...have {i}fun{/i} with people or whatever it is you do. I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 你不用整晚陪我坐在这儿，Uta。去社交一下，去和别人玩得{i}开心{/i}什么的。我没事。

lines.en: : Like heck you’re fine. You haven’t been fine in weeks. In fact, you’ve gotten even {i}worse{/i} since the Dorm Wars and you’re gonna have to tell me why eventually.
lines.zh: : 你才没事呢。你已经好几周都不好了。事实上，自从宿舍战争之后你变得{i}更糟{/i}了，你迟早得告诉我为什么。

lines.en: : Can you not just chalk it up to me being an unlovable meat-sack this time? That’s always worked in the past.
lines.zh: : 这次你不能直接归结为「我是个不值得被爱的肉袋子」吗？这招以前一直管用。

lines.en: : Maybe for you. But you’re the {i}most{/i} lovable meat-sack to me.
lines.zh: : 也许对你来说吧。但对我来说，你是{i}最{/i}值得被爱的肉袋子。

lines.en: scene utaioinn2
: I’m confused. Was that supposed to be a compliment?
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。那算是夸奖吗？

lines.en: : It sounded better in my head, okay? I’m just trying to remind you that you can-
lines.zh: : 在我脑子里听起来更好，好吗？我只是想提醒你，你可

lines.en: : Talk to you whenever I want. I know. You’ve told me that probably fifty times today alone.
lines.zh: : 随时可以找你谈。我知道。光今天一天你大概就说了五十遍了。

lines.en: : Yet you haven’t even {i}tried!{/i} I can tell when something’s wrong, Io. I’ve known you for years.
lines.zh: : 可你连试都没{i}试过{/i}！我看得出来有事，Io。我认识你这么多年了。

lines.en: : Well, look at it this way — if something was {i}really{/i} wrong, would I have bothered coming here at all?
lines.zh: : 那这么想——如果{i}真{/i}出了大事，我还愿意来这儿吗？

lines.en: scene utaioinn3
: Yes! That’s exactly when you {i}would{/i} bother coming here because you’d think something like, “If I don’t come, Uta will think something is wrong and I don’t want her to think that.”
lines.zh: : 会！你恰恰会在那时候来，因为你会这么想：「如果我不去，Uta 会觉得出事了，而我不想让她那么想。」

lines.en: : So you wouldn’t think anything was wrong if I actually stayed at home?
lines.zh: : 那要是我真待在家里，你就不会觉得出事了？

lines.en: : No, I’d think something is wrong then too because your thought process would be, “Uta wants me to come but I am so beaten up that I don’t even have the energy to humor her right now.”
lines.zh: : 不，那时候我也会觉得出事了，因为你的思路会是：「Uta 想让我去，可我被打垮到连应付她的力气都没有了。」

lines.en: : Wow. I sound just as exhausting in your head as I do in mine.
lines.zh: : 哇。在你脑子里我听起来跟在我自己脑子里一样累人。

lines.en: : You are!
lines.zh: : 你就是！

lines.en: scene utaioinn4
: In fact, you’re {i}so{/i} exhausting that it makes me wanna blow my frickin’ brains out with my crossbow! And that’s not even a guaranteed instant kill! I’ve seen it happen! It’s gross!
lines.zh: : 事实上，你累人到让我想用我的弩把自己的脑子轰出来！而且那还不能保证一击毙命！我见过！可恶心了！

lines.en: : I thought you weren’t allowed to kill deer in Nara?
lines.zh: : 我记得在 Nara 是不许猎鹿的？

lines.en: : We're not, but that’s never stopped my brother. I’m not even talkin’ about that though. My uncle’s a matagi. He hunts bears in Akita.
lines.zh: : 是不许，可那从来拦不住我哥。不过我说的不是这个。我叔叔是 matagi。他在 Akita 猎熊。

lines.en: : With a {i}crossbow?{/i}
: He says it “softens them up” but that’s beside the point, Io! I’m tired of you hiding things from me when all it does is make it impossible to cheer you up! Let me help you!
lines.zh: : 他说那样能「让它们软下来」，但这不是重点，Io！我受够了你对我藏着掖着，而这只让我根本没法让你开心起来！让我帮你吧！

lines.en: : I’d love to, Uta. Except, here’s the thing — we both have stuff about our past that we quite literally found out we {i}can’t{/i} help each other with. That’s why we’re friends. Remember?
lines.zh: : 我也想啊，Uta。不过问题是——我们俩都有各自过去的事，而且我们其实早就发现那些事我们帮不了对方。这才是我们成为朋友的原因。记得吗？

lines.en: scene utaioinn5
: Of course I remember! But-
lines.zh: : 我当然记得！但是——

lines.en: : We’re done here. If you want to have girl-talk, there are like fifty other girls in the rooms down the hall you can go hang out with.
lines.zh: : 到此为止吧。你要是想聊闺蜜话题，走廊那头的房间里还有大概五十个女孩可以陪你。
: Io……

lines.en: : She didn’t, like...show up again...did she?...
lines.zh: : 她没有……又出现吧……对吗？……

lines.en: scene utaioinn6
: I thought you said she was still outside of Kumon-mi? I thought-
lines.zh: : 我以为你说她还在 Kumon-mi 外面？我以为——

lines.en: : I’d have asked for your help burying a body by now if that’s what happened, Uta.
lines.zh: : 如果真发生了那种事，我早就找你帮忙埋尸体了，Uta。

lines.en: : But...why would you bring up the things we {i}can’t{/i} help each other with if that’s not what’s going on here? I don’t get it. Why do you make it always so hard to understand what’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 可是……如果不是这么回事，你为什么要提那些我们帮不了对方的事？我不明白。你为什么总是让人这么难搞懂到底出了什么问题？

lines.en: : It’s just better off that way.
lines.zh: : 就这样更好。

lines.en: scene utaioinn7
: Sometimes...the less you know, the better.
lines.zh: : 有时候……知道得越少越好。

lines.en: : Life’s messy enough as is. The last thing either one of us needs is one more thing to cry about. Mostly you, though. Crying is exhausting and makes my head hurt.
lines.zh: : 生活本来就够乱的了。我们谁都不需要再多一件能哭的事。主要是你。哭太累人了，还让我头疼。

lines.en: : So something {i}did{/i} happen and you’re just purposely choosing to keep me in the dark.
lines.zh: : 所以{i}确实{/i}发生了什么，而你故意选择把我蒙在鼓里。

lines.en: scene utaioinn8
: Yeah. That’s right.
lines.zh: : 对。没错。

lines.en: : Don’t smile at me, Io. Do you have any idea how mad that makes me?
lines.zh: : 别对我笑，Io。你知道那让我多生气吗？

lines.en: if iospring3 == True:

: Do you have any idea how mad you’d be if I told you the truth? Because it’s way worse. So just let me feel like shit for a little longer and you’ll get to keep your entire world-view intact. Sound good?
lines.zh: : 你知道如果我告诉你真相，你会有多生气吗？因为那糟得多。所以就让我再难受一阵子，你也能保住你完整的世界观。听起来不错吧？

lines.en: : Horrible, actually. It makes me feel like you have zero faith in me when I would trust you with my life.
lines.zh: : 糟透了，真的。我愿意把命交给你，你这样让我觉得你对我毫无信任。

lines.en: : Trusting me with anything more than tools is just an accident waiting to happen, so I implore you to reconsider.
lines.zh: : 除了工具之外，把任何东西托付给我都只是一场等待发生的事故，所以我恳请你重新考虑。

lines.en: else:
: I mean, yeah. You’re making that pretty obvious right now. But, at the same time, you’re kind of blowing things way out of proportion.
lines.zh: : 我是说，是啊。你现在表现得相当明显。但与此同时，你也有点小题大做了。

lines.en: scene utaioinn10
: How am {i}I{/i} the one blowing things out of proportion when all I’ve done over the last couple weeks is try to get ahold of you?
lines.zh: : 我这两个星期所做的全部努力就是联系上你，怎么反倒成了{i}我{/i}在小题大做？

lines.en: : Repeat that last sentence, just a little slower.
lines.zh: : 把最后那句话再说一遍，慢一点。

lines.en: : Okay. So I’m clingy. Yeah. But I’ve always been clingy. And you-
lines.zh: : 好吧。所以我很黏人。对。可我一直都很黏人。而你——

lines.en: : And I’ve always been a scared and confused piece of shit.
lines.zh: : 而我一直是坨又怂又迷糊的狗屎。

lines.en: scene utaioinn11
: But, like...
lines.zh: : 不过呢……

lines.en: : It’s been mostly just “confused” lately. That’s why I’ve been so absent.
lines.zh: : 最近主要是「迷糊」而已。所以我才老是缺席。

lines.en: : Like yeah, a thing happened. I had to confront some stuff I hate confronting. But for the first time in my life, it didn’t end in complete and utter tragedy.
lines.zh: : 没错，确实发生了件事。我不得不面对一些我讨厌面对的东西。但有生以来第一次，它并没有以彻头彻尾的悲剧收场。

lines.en: : Maybe I’m just having a hard time figuring out what that means and where to go from here. It’s all sort of...uncharted territory for me. But it’s nothing personal.
lines.zh: : 也许我只是很难弄清这意味着什么、接下来该往哪儿走。这一切对我来说……算是未知领域。但这不是针对你。

lines.en: : I’m just keeping you out of it since you have more than enough on your plate already.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想把你卷进来，毕竟你手头的事已经够多了。

lines.en: scene utaioinn9
: So you’re really not gonna tell me?...
lines.zh: : 所以你真的不打算告诉我？……

lines.en: : I’m really not gonna tell you.
lines.zh: : 我真的不打算告诉你。

lines.en: : Trust me. You’ll be way happier this way.
lines.zh: : 相信我。这样你会开心得多。

lines.en: : But what about you?
lines.zh: : 可你呢？

lines.en: if iospring3 == True:
: Uta, come on.
lines.zh: : Uta，拜托。

lines.en: : There’s barely a “me” left at this point.
lines.zh: : 到这一步，「我」已经所剩无几了。

lines.en: else:
: What {i}about{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 我怎么了？

lines.en: : Are {i}you{/i} really going to be happy about this if you just bottle everything up again?
lines.zh: : 如果你又把一切都憋在心里，{i}你{/i}真的会开心吗？

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : For the first time ever, I think I might.
lines.zh: : 有生以来第一次，我觉得也许会。

lines.en: : Attention, roommates!
lines.zh: : 室友们注意！

lines.en: scene utaioinn12
: The most attractive women in Kumon-mi have returned.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 最有魅力的女人们回来了。

lines.en: : And we’ve come bearing gifts!
lines.zh: : 我们还带着礼物来了！

lines.en: : Is that a friggin’ crab?
lines.zh: : 那是只该死的螃蟹？

lines.en: : This little guy wandered up to us while we were diggin’ in the sand earlier and now Tsuneyo’s gonna kill him.
lines.zh: : 这小家伙刚才我们在沙子里挖东西的时候自己爬过来了，现在 Tsuneyo 要宰了它。

lines.en: : I have provided for this family. I am a strong, independent woman who don’t need no man.
lines.zh: : 我为这个家提供了食物。我是一个不需要男人的强大独立女性。

lines.en: scene utaioinn13
: You feelin’ any better over there, Io? Still want me leavin’ you alone?
lines.zh: : 你那边好点了吗，Io？还想让我别管你吗？

lines.en: : Are you really going to kill that thing in our room?
lines.zh: : 你真打算在我们房间里宰了那东西？

lines.en: : You need to stop dodging the question when people ask you how you’re feeling.
lines.zh: : 别人问你感觉怎么样的时候，你别老是回避问题。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about me. I just think that thing’s cute and I don’t want to watch it die.
lines.zh: : 别管我。我只是觉得那小东西挺可爱的，不想看着它死。

lines.en: : I understand now. She is unwell because she never learned how to close her eyes.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。她之所以不舒服，是因为她从来没学会闭上眼睛。

lines.en: scene utaioinn14
: How horrible she must feel for my attractiveness to be entirely inescapable.
lines.zh: : 我的魅力完全避无可避，她一定难受极了。

lines.en: : Nah, I think she’s just got that depression thingy Makoto has.
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得她只是得了 Makoto 那种抑郁症。

lines.en: : See? Ya can tell by the sigh.
lines.zh: : 你看？光听那声叹气就知道了。

lines.en: : You two might wanna close the door before Io goes on a crazy rant about depression again.
lines.zh: : 你们俩最好把门关上，免得 Io 又开始就抑郁症发疯长篇大论。

lines.en: scene utaioinn15
: Understood. But please advise as to whether or not the two of you will be partaking in our crustaceous bounty.
lines.zh: : 明白。不过请告知，你们两位是否要共享这份甲壳类的馈赠。

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s only a matter of time ‘til this thing latches onto me. I just hope it’ll be easier to get off than the friggin’ blobfish.
lines.zh: : 对。这玩意儿迟早会夹住我。我只希望它比那条该死的鮟鱇鱼好弄下来。

lines.en: : I’m not hungry. Thanks, though.
lines.zh: : 我不饿。不过谢谢。

lines.en: : We’ll both eat. Thanks for cooking, Tsunecchi.
lines.zh: : 我们俩都吃。谢谢你做饭，Tsunecchi。

lines.en: scene black
: Your wish is my command.
lines.zh: : 你的愿望就是我的命令。

lines.en: : Wish? You some kinda genie n’AAAAAAH FRICK! HE’S GOT MY FINGER! I’M GONNA HAVE TO USE MY OTHER HAND FOR...STUFF NOW!
lines.zh: : 愿望？你当自己是神灯精吗——啊啊啊我操！它夹住我的手指了！我以后只能用另一只手来做……那些事了！

lines.en: scene utaioinn16
: Uta, what the hell? I just said I wasn’t hungry.
lines.zh: : Uta，搞什么？我刚说了我不饿。

lines.en: : Yes, but it is my duty as your best friend to feed you when you’re not feeling like yourself.
lines.zh: : 是，但作为你最好的朋友，在你状态不对的时候喂饱你，是我的职责。

lines.en: : Is it? Have I been neglecting my duties for the entire duration of our friendship?
lines.zh: : 是吗？那我们整段友谊里，我是不是一直都怠于履行自己的职责？

lines.en: : I love you. Okay?
lines.zh: : 我爱你。好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I love you too. But why do you need to be three inches from my face to tell me that?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也爱你。可你为什么非得凑到我脸前三英寸来说这个？

lines.en: : Because I need you to understand it.
lines.zh: : 因为我需要你明白。

lines.en: : I get that you don’t want to talk about whatever it is that happened. And yeah, that makes me really sad, but I’ll accept it so long as you {i}promise{/i} to come to me if it ever gets unbearable, okay?
lines.zh: : 我明白你不想谈发生的那些事。而且是啊，这让我很难过，但只要你{i}保证{/i}，如果哪天到了无法承受的地步你会来找我，我就接受，好吗？

lines.en: scene utaioinn17
: Okay.
: You really promise?
lines.zh: : 你真的保证？

lines.en: : I really promise.
lines.zh: : 我真的保证。

lines.en: : Really really?
lines.zh: : 真的真的？

lines.en: : Really really.
lines.zh: : 真的真的。

lines.en: scene utaioinn18
: Okay...
: Okay.
: Now it’s your turn!
lines.zh: : 现在轮到你了！

lines.en: scene utaioinn19
: My turn to what?
lines.zh: : 轮到我去干什么？

lines.en: : Attempt to withstand my verbal assault as I become a hypocrite once more and say some stuff about how you should talk to me when you have problems.
lines.zh: : 试着承受我的言语轰炸——我要再次当一回伪君子，说些「你有烦恼就该跟我说」之类的话。

lines.en: : I have problems?
lines.zh: : 我有烦恼？

lines.en: : Mhm.
: Current ones?
lines.zh: : 现在的？

lines.en: : Mhm.
: Unless you’ve already managed to forget that our teacher had some very inappropriate pictures of you on his phone.
lines.zh: : 除非你已经忘了，我们老师的手机里存着一些你非常不雅的照片。

lines.en: scene utaioinn20
: Oh...{i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦……{i}那个{/i}啊。

lines.en: : So you really did forget then? Wish I could do that. Life would be like five hundred times easier.
lines.zh: : 所以你真的忘了？真希望我也能忘。那样人生会轻松五百倍。

lines.en: : I haven’t forgotten, but...
lines.zh: : 我没忘，不过……

lines.en: : Maybe, like...
lines.zh: : 也许，就是……

lines.en: scene utaioinn21
: Maybe that’s...not as big of an issue as...it sounds?....
lines.zh: : 也许那件事……没有听起来那么严重？……

lines.en: : Not an issue, Uta? Really?
lines.zh: : 不严重，Uta？真的？

lines.en: scene utaioinn22
: Have you forgotten why you’re here too? Why you had to leave your hometown behind? Come up with a brand new style and persona? Have you forgotten {i}all{/i} of that?
lines.zh: : 你也忘了自己为什么在这儿吗？为什么必须离开故乡？为什么得打造一个全新的风格与人格？那些你{i}全都{/i}忘了吗？

lines.en: : Of course not...
lines.zh: : 当然没有……

lines.en: : Then how can you look me in the eyes like that and tell me it’s not a problem?
lines.zh: : 那你怎么能这样看着我的眼睛，告诉我那不是问题？

lines.en: : Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: : I think I’m in love with him.
lines.zh: : 我想我是爱上他了。

lines.en: scene utaioinn23
: You’re...
lines.zh: : 你是……

lines.en: : You’re {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : And so...I don’t mind...so long as it’s {i}him.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以……我不介意……只要是{i}他{/i}的话。

lines.en: : You mean like...you’re in love with him like you were in love with Spongebob Squarepants?
lines.zh: : 你是说……你爱他，就像你当初爱 Spongebob Squarepants 那样？

lines.en: : Wha- of course not...
lines.zh: : 什——当然不是……

lines.en: : Or that boy who used to work at the convenience store? Or Tony the Tiger? Or that boy who used to work at the library? Or whatever the Cheetos cat’s name is?
lines.zh: : 还是像那个在便利店打工的男生？或者 Tony the Tiger？或者那个在图书馆打工的男生？或者奇多那只猫叫什么来着？

lines.en: : Chester. But Io, this is different from all of those things...
lines.zh: : Chester。但 Io，这次跟那些都不一样……

lines.en: : And the reason I’m telling you is because you specifically {i}told{/i} me to not let you be the barrier between us. And you {i}won’t{/i} be. I just...
lines.zh: : 而我告诉你的原因，是因为你特地{i}跟我说过{/i}，别让你成为我们之间的障碍。而你不会。我只是……

lines.en: : I really don’t know if I can hold back any longer.
lines.zh: : 我真的不知道自己还能再忍多久。

lines.en: scene utaioinn24
: Any {i}longer?!{/i} How long has this been going on for?!
lines.zh: : 还能忍{i}多久{/i}？！这都多久了？！

lines.en: : Too long...and I’m sorry. I just didn’t want to hurt you and-
lines.zh: : 太久了……对不起。我只是不想伤害你，而且——

lines.en: : Uta, you fucking moron! I literally {i}told{/i} you I wanted this to happen so the {i}three{/i} of us could be together!
lines.zh: : Uta，你这白痴！我明明{i}跟你说过{/i}，我希望发生这种事，好让我们{i}三个人{/i}在一起！

lines.en: scene utaioinn25
: You did, yeah! But that was a really fucking weird thing to suggest and I refused to believe you were actually serious!
lines.zh: : 你是说过，对！但那个提议实在他妈的太奇怪了，我不肯相信你是认真的！

lines.en: : Of {i}course{/i} I was serious, you idiot. God, this changes everything! Why didn’t you tell me sooner?
lines.zh: : 我{i}当然{/i}是认真的，你这傻瓜。天啊，这改变了一切！你为什么不早点告诉我？

lines.en: : Because I {i}don’t{/i} want to be part of a throuple, Io!
lines.zh: : 因为我不想加入什么三人关系，Io！

lines.en: scene utaioinn26
: I want to be with him as a traditional couple. Two people. That’s it.
lines.zh: : 我想和他像传统情侣那样在一起。两个人。就这些。

lines.en: : I don’t want anyone else holding his hand. I don’t want anyone else cuddling with him. I don’t want anyone else kissing him. I want him and all of him and I would give him all of me in return.
lines.zh: : 我不想有别人牵他的手。我不想有别人和他依偎。我不想有别人吻他。我要的是他，完整的他，而我也会把我的一切都给他。

lines.en: : But, Io...I will throw away even the {i}idea{/i} of that right now if you ask me to. Because you are even {i}more{/i} important to me than he is.
lines.zh: : 但是，Io……只要你开口，我现在就可以把那个{i}念头{/i}连根拔掉。因为你对我来说，甚至比他{i}更{/i}重要。

lines.en: : What the fuck do you expect me to say to that, Uta?...
lines.zh: : 你他妈指望我说什么，Uta？……

lines.en: : Do you really think I’m going to look you in the eyes and tell you not to follow your heart when I want {i}you{/i} to find happiness even more than I want that for myself? Do you really think I’d do that?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我会看着你的眼睛，叫你不要追随自己的心吗——明明我希望{i}你{/i}找到幸福，甚至超过希望我自己找到幸福？你真觉得我会那么做？

lines.en: : That’s not-
lines.zh: : 那不是——

lines.en: : Go after him, Uta.
lines.zh: : 去追他吧，Uta。

lines.en: : Get married. Buy a house. Adopt Sir Meowington the 5th. Make babies. Do {i}all{/i} of that shit and leave me behind because I clearly {i}am{/i} a barrier between you two.
lines.zh: : 结婚。买房。领养 Sir Meowington the 5th。生孩子。把那些事{i}全{/i}做了，把我抛在身后，因为我显然{i}就是{/i}你俩之间的障碍。

lines.en: : But promise me that you’re 10000%% sure. Because you’ve said it yourself that you’re impulsive and-
lines.zh: : 但你得向我保证，你百分之一万确定。因为你自己都说过你很冲动，而且——

lines.en: : I’m 10000000%% sure...but I am {i}not{/i} leaving you behind. Ever.
lines.zh: : 我百分之一千万确定……可我{i}绝对{/i}不会把你抛下。永远不会。

lines.en: : I’m just going to get in the way.
lines.zh: : 我只会碍事。

lines.en: : Then I’ll make room so you can fit.
lines.zh: : 那我就腾出位置，好让你挤进来。

lines.en: : So the throuple is back on?
lines.zh: : 所以三人关系又回来了？

lines.en: scene utaioinn27
: Ugh...I don’t know. This is all so confusing.
lines.zh: : 呃……我不知道。这一切太让人混乱了。

lines.en: : There are like seven billion people in the world and we both had to fall for the same one. It’s not fair.
lines.zh: : 世界上有七十亿人，我们俩偏偏要爱上同一个。这不公平。

lines.en: : Yeah, but at least {i}you{/i} can give him what he wants.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但至少{i}你{/i}能给他想要的东西。

lines.en: scene utaioinn28
: You don’t know for sure {i}that’s{/i} what he wants, Io.
lines.zh: : 你并不能确定{i}那就是{/i}他想要的，Io。

lines.en: if iospring3 == True:
: God, I wish you were right...but you’re not.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我真希望你是对的……可你不是。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} know that’s what he wants...now more than ever. Which also means that I know it just...wouldn’t work.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}知道那就是他想要的……现在比以往任何时候都确定。而这也意味着，我知道那件事……根本行不通。

lines.en: : So go. Don’t even think about me. I’ll just...watch the game from the dugout or something.
lines.zh: : 所以去吧。别管我。我就……在场边看看比赛什么的。

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: else:
: You have just as good of a chance as me...
lines.zh: : 你的机会跟我一样大……

lines.en: : You’re asking me to compete with literal perfection.
lines.zh: : 你这是要我跟字面意义上的完美竞争。

lines.en: : I’m asking you to compete with the hollowed out shell of a girl whose head keeps falling off of her shoulders every single time she hops out of bed.
lines.zh: : 我是要你跟一个被掏空的躯壳竞争——那个女孩每次跳下床，脑袋都从肩膀上掉下来。

lines.en: : I’m a mess, Io. It’s Uta-{i}chan{/i} who’s perfect.
lines.zh: : 我一团糟，Io。完美的那个是 Uta-{i}chan{/i}。

lines.en: : They’re both you, Uta. They’ve always {i}been{/i} you. And none of those flaws are actually flaws to me.
lines.zh: : 她们都是你啊，Uta。她们一直都是你。而那些所谓的缺点，对我来说根本不是缺点。

lines.en: : So go. Don’t even think about me. I’ll just...watch the game from the dugout or something.
lines.zh: : 所以去吧。别管我。我就……在场边看看比赛什么的。

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : {i}Oi! Food’s almost done! You two gonna eat out here with us or do ya wanna come grab some yourselves?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}喂！饭快好了！你们俩是要出来跟我们一起吃，还是想自己过来拿？{/i}

lines.en: : Pause?
lines.zh: : 暂停？

lines.en: : Pause. You were right. I’m hungry now.
lines.zh: : 暂停。你说得对。我现在饿了。

lines.en: : Do you still love me?
lines.zh: : 你还爱我吗？

lines.en: : Do you still love {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你还爱{i}我{/i}吗？

lines.en: : I’ll always love you.
lines.zh: : 我会永远爱你。

lines.en: : I’ll always love you too.
lines.zh: : 我也会永远爱你。

lines.en: : Wanna just leave Sensei behind and go get married ourselves?
lines.zh: : 要不干脆把 Sensei 甩了，我们自己结婚去？

lines.en: : Can we eat first? I haven’t had anything since last night.
lines.zh: : 能先吃吗？我从昨晚起就没吃过东西。

lines.en: scene black
: And this is exactly why best friends feed one another...
lines.zh: : 所以好朋友才要互相喂食……

lines.en: And so the four girls partake in the consumption of the body of Christ.
lines.zh: 于是四个女孩分食了基督的身体。

lines.en: I mean crab.
lines.zh: 我是说螃蟹。

lines.en: The four girls partake in the consumption of the body of crab.
lines.zh: 四个女孩分食了螃蟹的身体。

lines.en: But you and me go somewhere more fun.
lines.zh: 但你和我，去个更有趣的地方。
